text:
Situation: Sevoflurane inventory at Corvale East is critically low. The 250 mL bottle has 89 units on hand (13 days); the 1 mL/mL 250 mL bottle has 41 units (4.6 days). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 385.79 units (28.3 and 18.5 days). A transfer can stabilize Corvale East without jeopardizing Corvale General.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 683318 of Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 2650090) ended 2010-09-30 and was classified OAI with known date 2010-12-29. Subsequent Baxter inspections were classified VAI on 2015-02-06, 2018-10-24, and 2025-03-26. Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) received an OAI classification on 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08. Bryant Ranch Prepack has since received VAI classifications through the most recent inspection ending 2026-07-16. Sevoflurane is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest, lowest-risk step. External purchases are available from multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list, but their labels do not identify a specific plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 92 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Place purchase orders with AbbVie Inc., Baxter Healthcare Company, Halocarbon Life Sciences LLC, and Lannett Company Inc. — requires buyer approval for each order.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new deliveries; Corvale East will fall below two weeks' supply within days.
